title: Genie 4 is now available
headline: Google DeepMind updates Project Genie with safety and watermarking features
summary: Google DeepMind has released Genie 4, an interactive world model, alongside updates to its Project Genie platform. The release includes integrated safety screenings for all model inputs and outputs. Additionally, all audio and video content generated by the platform now incorporates SynthID watermarking.
why_it_matters: Organisations deploying generative AI must implement robust safety screening and provenance mechanisms like watermarking to manage risks associated with synthetic content generation.

quotes.text: All video and audio generated in Project Genie includes SynthID watermarking, and all model inputs and outputs go through safety screenings.
We are committed to developing and rolling out interactive world models responsibly.

dates_mentioned.what: Release of the new Project Genie experience

classification.significance_reason: Demonstrates the integration of safety and provenance features into frontier research models.
